eligible_structure_rules: a derived line cannot claim a filed concept
a filed subtotal may only be actual/tie authority or unavailable
diluted weighted-average shares require duration direct_annual shares
only diluted weighted-average shares may carry annual_forecast_method
Only diluted weighted-average shares may select
sum formula roles do not match its company statement output
EPS denominator must be diluted weighted-average shares
EPS numerator must use the company-specific diluted EPS numerator role
company-presented components must be filed and subtotals must be derived
diluted EPS cannot be aggregated from quarterly EPS

eps_numerator_bridge.guidance: Keep accounting net_income separate from diluted_eps_numerator. When net income is calculated from pretax income, taxes and filed company components, retain that line and its formula with role net_income; do not retag it diluted_eps_numerator. Add a separate derived numerator bridge using the exact net_income or parent_net_income line and only disclosed dilution adjustments. If the filed diluted EPS proves that net income itself is the numerator, the bridge is sum(+1 * net-income), and the EPS divide refers to this bridge and the filed diluted shares. A numerator sum cannot directly use pretax_income or income_tax_expense. Tie the accounting total and numerator to their exact filed authorities and validate the numerator through filed diluted EPS in every period. Missing dilution evidence remains unavailable, never zero.
